id.description: Unique identifier for this monitoring resource. Use as the {id} path parameter to update or delete the record via /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/monitoring_resources/{id}.

description.description: Free-text label for the monitoring resource, typically the resource or role being tracked.

start_date.description: Date the resource begins, in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Date the resource ends, in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

unit_of_measure.description: Time unit over which the resource is spread between start_date and end_date.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of measure for this resource.

units_remaining.description: Units still remaining as of today, or as of the forecast_start_date query parameter when provided.

forecast_to_complete.description: Remaining cost forecast to complete this resource (units_remaining multiplied by unit_cost and utilization).

planned_total_cost.description: Total planned cost for this resource across its full duration.

total_units.description: Total number of units scheduled between start_date and end_date.

utilization.description: Fraction of the resource applied per unit, expressed as a decimal where 1.0 is 100%.

budget_line_item_id.description: ID of the budget line item this monitoring resource is tracked against.

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity
